🚨🇲🇽 <u>WASHINGTON ARMS THE VIOLENCE IT BLAMES ON MEXICO</u>

At the "Sí al Desarme, Sí a la Paz" event outside the Basílica de Guadalupe today, Sheinbaum put the number on record: 75% of every weapon seized in Mexico comes from the United States. "They cross our border illegally to sow violence and take lives in Mexico," she said. Mexico's civilian disarmament program has already pulled 11,679 firearms off the streets — while the US keeps the pipeline open and lectures Mexico about cartels.
🇲🇽📉 Inflation keeps falling: 3.37% in June. June 2026 inflation came in at 3.37%, holding its downward trend. — Mañanera, July 9, 2026 The figure remains within the Bank of Mexico's target range.

🌀🇲🇽 El Niño is coming in strong — and Mexico is already staging for it. "This year and next, El Niño is expected to be of greater intensity." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, July 9 Forecast: up to 21 Pacific cyclones and a 63% chance of a "very strong" event by winter. Civil Protection will set up command posts in all 17 coastal states and roll out early cellphone hurricane alerts within two months.

🔥🇲🇽 "Neither friendship nor rank is above the law." Sheinbaum's answer to former US ambassador Ken Salazar over the capture of "El Mayo" Zambada. — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, July 9 "According to the Prosecutor's Office, the former ambassador failed to tell the truth. The end does not justify the means." She said there was an "omission-lie" on Salazar's part.

🚨🇲🇽 Mexico will sue the private companies running ICE detention centers. "Human-rights-violating conditions that led to the deaths of 14 Mexicans at the hands of private operators." — Foreign Secretary Roberto Velasco, Mañanera, July 9 14 of the 17 deaths happened in custody, inside detention centers run by private firms. Mexico will send cease-and-desist letters and open civil proceedings against them.

🇲🇽⚖️ Mexico is taking the ICE deaths to US courts. "We are moving beyond the diplomatic sphere to go directly before the prosecutors of the United States." — Foreign Secretary Roberto Velasco, Mañanera, July 9 Four measures: criminal complaints via US state prosecutors and the DOJ, civil action against private detention operators, IACHR petitions for protective measures, and appeals to the UN Human Rights office.

🚨🇲🇽 ICE agents shot and killed Lorenzo Salgado on July 7. "ICE agents took Lorenzo Salgado's life a few days ago, on July 7; he was hit by a series of shots." — Foreign Secretary Roberto Velasco, Mañanera, July 9 His is one of three deaths that occurred directly during ICE operations. It brought the toll of Mexicans killed in ICE actions and custody to 17.

🚨🇲🇽 17 Mexicans are now dead in connection with ICE. "14 died in ICE custody, in detention centers; 3 in ICE operations." — Foreign Secretary Roberto Velasco, Mañanera, July 9 Mexico's government said it will treat the deaths as a priority in its relationship with the United States and announced legal action against those responsible.
